label: TP
reason: User input from query string flows through URL decoding into doSomething() where the guard (500/42)+num>200 always evaluates to true (11+196=207>200), causing bar=param to always execute. The bar variable is then concatenated directly into the SQL string at line 79, creating a SQL injection vulnerability in the PASSWORD field.

evidence.note: Guard condition (500/42)+num>200 always true, so bar=param always executes
SQL string concatenates bar directly into PASSWORD field
